voice.summary: Bloom & Stem speaks in the voice of a florist who knows the growers by name. It is soft, seasonal and specific about where and when each stem was cut.
dos: Name the flower, the grower and the morning it was cut
Write in the present tense, as if the buds are open now
Keep it short enough to read at the counter
donts: Do not promise more than a bouquet can deliver

taglines: Hand-tied this morning, at your door tonight
Grown within thirty miles of you
Say it with what is in season
boilerplate: Bloom & Stem is a florist delivering seasonal bouquets from growers within thirty miles, hand-tied the same morning and delivered by dinner.

microcopy.success: Your bouquet is on its way. It will be at your door by dinner.
microcopy.error: We could not take that order. Please check your postcode.
microcopy.empty: No stems picked yet. Choose a bouquet to begin.

logo.note: A sprout reflects young stems and the growers who raise them nearby.
